## Review checklist

- [ ] The diff is bounded to the authorized outcome.
- [ ] No required gate, test, policy, or provenance control was weakened to make the change pass.
- [ ] Security-sensitive behavior includes the required negative/adversarial evidence.
- [ ] Cross-platform claims are backed by applicable evidence rather than assumption.
- [ ] Documentation/evidence reflects the exact candidate rather than stale hashes or runs.
- [ ] No secrets, PHI, personal data, or unpublished vulnerability details are exposed.
- [ ] Post-merge qualification/closeout requirements are identified.
